name: zerodha-equity-delivery-sell-100k-after-dp-revision
describes: The same sell again after 2026-06-19, when Zerodha cut its share of the depository fee from Rs 10.25 to Rs 9.50, taking the charge from Rs 13.50 to Rs 13.00 before GST; from 1-3-2026 the separate IPFT contribution is Rs 0.01 per crore, nil on this size (W-185). Three generations of one card now price three windows, and each fixture pins the one it belongs to.
